label: ESTIMATE, not a user test
what: Manual minutes per unit x units per week, chore by chore along the app's five steps, against the app's measured response times plus a labelled reading and editing time. Two scenarios: a focused list of 40 organisations (S6) and a wide sweep of the 272 organisations that hired Yale SOM MBAs in 2025-26 (S7). Low = every input at its low value; high = every input at its high value.
not_modelled: applications and cover letters, interview and case preparation, info sessions and school events, the coffee chats themselves (reported separately). These are inside the 15-25 h/week a career office advises (S1).
cost_source: docs/evidence/runs/2026-10-26_cost_model.json (typical month of report Section 5, itself an estimate; NOT this scenario's use)
cost_this_usage_note: the use assumed in the focused scenario (3-5 people searches, 1-3 web shortlists, one web answer per chat a week) at the measured cost per request, 52/12 weeks a month; mostly people searches
